messages:
oliver: Planning thread 1 1 - rollout plan for multi-variant routing + staged regional deploy. Need explicit roll cadence, quality gates, and rollback ladders. Keeping it lean for PLG customers first.

jana: Proposal: "slow-surge" approach: 1%  5%  15%  40%  75%  100%. Durations: steps 1-3 = 20m, step 4 = 1h, step 5 = 3h, final = 6h. Auto-skip allowed only if p95 < 300ms and 5-min errors < 0.3%.

riley: Quality gating: run A/B on golden prompts every step. Need at least 1k samples per arm for 90% power. Acceptance metric = human-in-the-loop accept rate OR automated semantic score. For immediate detection add classification probe for hallucination rate.

kevin: Fallbacks: two-tier fallback. Tier A = `model-safe` (lighter quant, quality-checked). Tier B = `model-legacy` (current prod). Fallback trigger: if p95 > 450ms OR error rate > 0.6% OR hallucination probe > 2%. On trigger: move 100% to Tier A for 10m; if not resolved, escalate to Tier B and page. Preserve request affinity cookie to avoid cross-chat races.

ops-bot: ops-bot: applied flag regional-slow-surge to us-east-1 step=1 pct=1 at ts=2398768440.

qa-bot: qa-bot: started golden set job run id=gs-1122 for step=1. collecting samples.

oliver: Ownership notes:
- jana -> orchestrate flag rollout + PR with start offsets
- riley -> A/B harness + sample collection
- kevin -> fallback implementations + affinity cookie
- ops -> add cooldown check: require 15m of stable infra metrics before moving cross-region.

oliver: Launch criteria: gating infra metrics (p95 < 350ms, errors <0.4%), quality pass p<0.05 and >1% absolute lift vs baseline on accept rate. If any step fails, auto-revert that region to last-known-good variant and hold. Full rollback if >1 region fails within 20m.

riley: I'll add chi-squared test for categorical outcomes and bootstrap for semantic score CIs. We'll fail open only for small regressions (<0.5% abs) and on low traffic slices.

jana: Let's also include a canary traffic mirror stream so we can compare logs without impacting users; mirror to internal-only cluster.

kevin: Noted. Also adding a `soft-fallback` that routes slow-serving requests to a degraded path that returns short answers (to satisfy latency SLOs) while preserving context. Requires app-level support.

oliver: Action items and timeline:
- jana -> flag PR + region schedule by EOD Thu
- riley -> golden prompt harness by Mon
- kevin -> fallback lambda and affinity cookie by Mon
- ops -> add cooldown and mirror by Tue
Target: start warm-up next Wed if no blockers. Tagging: @jana @riley @kevin.

oliver: closing for action tracking. will file rollout doc and link PRs here. Thanks!
